title: A Guide to Recovering Overgrown Garden
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: What is the best way to repair an overgrown garden ?
sentences.zh: 什么是最好的方法 修复一个过度生长的花园?

sentences.en: Garden expert for the Associated Press Jessica Damiano believes she knows the answer.
sentences.zh: 美联社的花园专家 杰西卡・达米诺相信她知道答案

sentences.en: Here are some of her suggestions for making big improvements.
sentences.zh: 以下是她关于做出重大改进的建议。

sentences.en: Planning in the autumn and winter months can help you see something much more beautiful next winter: Decide what to clear away First, take a notebook with you and walk around the garden.
sentences.zh: 在秋天和冬季计划可以帮助你看到更美的下一年冬天:先决定什么可以清除,然后带着笔记本在花园里走动。

sentences.en: Look carefully at each part. Try to decide which plants can be saved, which to throw away, and which ones require attention.
sentences.zh: 仔细看每一部分。试着决定哪些植物可以保存,哪些可以丢弃,哪些需要注意。

sentences.en: Make a list as soon as you can. Dead plants, weeds and invasive plants should be first to go.
sentences.zh: 死植物、杂草和入侵植物应该先去

sentences.en: If the weather permits, dig them out, removing as much of their root systems as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果天气允许 把他们挖出来 尽可能多地去除根系

sentences.en: Otherwise, wait until spring to do this before planting.
sentences.zh: 否则,等到春天再耕种

sentences.en: Next, remove and give away healthy plants that you do not want.
sentences.zh: 接下来,除去并赠送健康植物 你不希望。

sentences.en: Online groups and neighborhood web pages are places to find people to receive the plants.
sentences.zh: 网络团体和邻里网页是找到接收植物的人的地方。

sentences.en: Many people will even be willing to do the digging if it means getting a free plant.
sentences.zh: 许多人甚至愿意做挖掘 如果这意味着得到一个免费的植物。

sentences.en: If the garden is full of plants, shrubs, trees and vines that have grown wild, you might need to use a chainsaw or heavy machine.
sentences.zh: 如果花园里充满了野生植物、灌木、树木和葡萄树,你可能需要用链锯或重型机器。

sentences.en: Define any new beds If there are a lot of weeds or if you want to create new garden beds, you can cover the existing vegetation rather than dig it up.
sentences.zh: 定义任何新床位 如果有很多杂草 或者你想创建新的花园床位 你可以覆盖现有的植被 而不是挖掘它

sentences.en: Decide the size and shape of the area you want to make into a new bed.
sentences.zh: 决定您想要建新床的区域的大小和形状 。

sentences.en: Cover that area with cardboard or lots of newspaper.
sentences.zh: 用纸板或很多报纸覆盖那个区域

sentences.en: Put about seven centimeters of compost and five centimeters of mulch on top of it.
sentences.zh: 上面大约放七厘米的堆肥和五厘米的沼气

sentences.en: You can start in the autumn and leave it there over the winter until planting time in the spring.
sentences.zh: 你可以从秋天开始,在冬天离开那里,直到春天播种。

sentences.en: When it is time to plant, cut holes in the cardboard or paper big enough for the roots of your plants.
sentences.zh: 当时机成熟时,在纸板或纸板上挖洞 足够你植物的根。

sentences.en: The covering over the ground will keep most weeds from growing.
sentences.zh: 地面的覆盖将防止大多数杂草生长。

sentences.en: Some weeds may break through and require pulling or more cardboard, Damiano said.
sentences.zh: 达米安诺说,有些杂草可能突破,需要拉动或更多纸板。

sentences.en: How and when to prune Healthy but overgrown or unproductive deciduous shrubs can be brought back to life by pruning . “Deciduous” means that the plants lose their leaves during the winter season.
sentences.zh: 如何以及何时通过砍伐使健康但生长过度或无益的枯萎灌木恢复生命。 “十足”意味着植物在冬季会失去叶子。

sentences.en: The best time to prune many plants is when their branches are bare in late winter.
sentences.zh: 采摘许多植物的最好时机 是在冬季末它们的树枝裸露的时候

sentences.en: Choosing a pruning method will require weighing appearance against the time it will take to recover.
sentences.zh: 选择修剪方法需要根据恢复所需的时间来权衡外观。

sentences.en: The fastest and most severe method would be to cut the whole plant down just above ground level.
sentences.zh: 最快和最严重的方法是将整个工厂从地面上削减。

sentences.en: Although extreme, many shrubs can deal with this form of pruning and will bounce back stronger.
sentences.zh: 许多灌木可以处理这种修剪方式 并且会反弹得更强

sentences.en: If keeping the plant looking normal is important, prune each branch or stem individually at uneven heights.
sentences.zh: 如果保持植物的正常状态很重要, 将每个树枝切除, 或以不均匀的高度单独生长。

sentences.en: It is also possible to cut back one-third of the plant's branches each year for three years.
sentences.zh: 此外,还可以在三年内每年削减该厂三分之一的分支。

sentences.en: That method would have the least severe effect but requires the most patience.
sentences.zh: 这种方法的效果将最小,但需要最耐心。

sentences.en: Evergreen trees and shrubs should only undergo light pruning such as the shortening of individual branches.
sentences.zh: 长青树和灌木只应进行轻剪,如缩短个别树枝。

sentences.en: Take care to avoid pruning too much or creating holes in evergreen plants and trees.
sentences.zh: 注意避免修剪太多或在常青植物和树木上造成漏洞。

sentences.en: With the exception of yews, they do not regrow from such damage.
sentences.zh: 除你们外,他们不因这种损失而复活。

sentences.en: Looking to the dirt Now that you have taken care of pruning, turn your attention to the soil.
sentences.zh: 看着泥土,现在你已经处理 修剪,你的注意力 转向土壤。

sentences.en: Test the soil's pH, or its acidity level.
sentences.zh: 测试土壤的pH值或酸度。

sentences.en: Do this to make sure the soil is good for the plants you plan to add.
sentences.zh: 这样做是为了确保土壤对您计划添加的植物有利。

sentences.en: Test kits are available at local garden stores and online.
sentences.zh: 当地花园商店和网上都有测试工具包。

sentences.en: In the United States, a cooperative extension service might provide soil testing and soil-amendment advice for a small cost.
sentences.zh: 在美国,合作推广服务可以提供土壤检验和土壤修正建议,以支付少量费用。

sentences.en: Cooperative extension services are part of a Department of Agriculture system that includes some universities.
sentences.zh: 合作推广服务是农业部系统的一部分,其中包括一些大学。

sentences.en: It aims to help farmers and people interested in plants.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助农民和对植物感兴趣的人。

sentences.en: If the soil is hard, break it up with a machine or hand tools.
sentences.zh: 如果土壤硬了,用机器或手动工具把它拆开

sentences.en: Finally, spread five to seven centimeters of compost over the area.
sentences.zh: 最后,把五到七厘米的堆肥分布在该地区。

sentences.en: As it breaks down, nutrients will work their way into the soil.
sentences.zh: 当它崩溃时 营养物质会流入土壤

sentences.en: Planting considerations After completing these steps, it will be time to plant your new garden.
sentences.zh: 完成这些步骤后,该是种新花园的时候了。

sentences.en: Choose new trees, shrubs or perennials , that will not grow wildly.
sentences.zh: 选择新树、灌木或常年树,

sentences.en: Dig holes as deep as their roots but two times as wide and space them out to their expected full-grown sizes.
sentences.zh: 挖洞的深度和根一样深 但宽度是他们的两倍 并让它们达到预期的完整体积

sentences.en: Native plants are good because they need little added water or special care.
sentences.zh: 土生植物是好的,因为它们需要很少的加水或特殊照顾。

sentences.en: Plant groundcover – short, spreading plants – to cover the ground and keep weeds from growing and the soil from drying out.
sentences.zh: 植物覆盖物 — — 短的、扩张的植物 — — 覆盖地面,防止杂草生长和土壤干涸。

sentences.en: It might take one or two years, but a step-by-step approach will make gardening a joy again.
sentences.zh: 这可能需要一两年, 但一步一步的方法 将使园艺再次带来欢乐。

sentences.en: And, perhaps best of all, you will see something beautiful when you look outside from your home.
sentences.zh: 而且,也许最好的,你会看到一些美丽的东西 当你看着外面的家。

sentences.en: I’m Jill Robbins. Jessica Damiano reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是Jill Robbins, Jessica Damiano为美联社报导了这个故事。

sentences.en: Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.
sentences.zh: 吉尔・罗宾斯改编了它 学习英语。
